Stow Players welcomes you!

We are a non-profit community theater organization enriching Stow and greater Northeast Ohio since 1953.
More about us...

What we do...

In addition to our full productions, we hold workshops and smaller events throughout the year.

Classes and Workshops

Yes, and ... you'll love it! No experience necessary. Only the ability to laugh is required.

Emerging Playwrights

Keep an eye out for hidden gems when we put on staged readings of new works.

Summer Theater Workshop

With Stow Parks & Rec, kids can enjoy an opportunity to be creative and develop theater skills.

It’s called community theater

Everything we do involves the dedicated cooperation and support of many great folks. Just like you!
Get involved!
